mapper.select: SELECT GENERATION, MEMORY_ENABLED FROM USER_PROFILE_OWNER WHERE 1=0
SELECT RECORD_ID, MEMORY_ID, MEMORY_TEXT, MEMORY_TYPE, CREATED_AT, SOURCE_CHAT_ID, MEMORY_STATE, REVISION, PINNED, EXPIRES_AT FROM USER_PROFILE_MEMORY WHERE 1=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_PROFILE_MEMORY (OWNER_KEY, MEMORY_ID, MEMORY_TEXT, MEMORY_TYPE, CREATED_AT, SOURCE_CHAT_ID, MEMORY_STATE) VALUES (#{ownerKey}, #{memoryId}, #{memoryText}, #{memoryType}, #{createdAt}, #{sourceChatId}, #{memoryState})
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(RECORD_ID) FROM USER_PROFILE_MEMORY WHERE OWNER_KEY=#{ownerKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_PROFILE_MEMORY SET MEMORY_TEXT=#{memoryText}, MEMORY_TYPE=#{memoryType}, MEMORY_STATE='ACTIVE', REVISION=REVISION+1, PINNED=#{pinned}, EXPIRES_AT=#{expiresAt} WHERE OWNER_KEY=#{ownerKey} AND RECORD_ID=#{recordId} AND REVISION=#{revision}
UPDATE USER_PROFILE_OWNER SET MEMORY_ENABLED=#{memoryEnabled}, GENERATION=GENERATION+1 WHERE OWNER_KEY=#{ownerKey}
mapper.select: SELECT AUDIT_ID, RECORD_ID, ACTION_CODE, REVISION, OCCURRED_AT FROM USER_PROFILE_AUDIT WHERE OWNER_KEY=#{ownerKey} AND AUDIT_ID<#{auditId} ORDER BY AUDIT_ID DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_PROFILE_OWNER (OWNER_KEY, TENANT_ID, USER_ID) VALUES (#{ownerKey}, #{tenantId}, #{userId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE OWNER_KEY=OWNER_KEY
mapper.select: SELECT GENERATION, MEMORY_ENABLED FROM USER_PROFILE_OWNER WHERE OWNER_KEY=#{ownerKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_PROFILE_OWNER SET GENERATION=GENERATION+1 WHERE OWNER_KEY=#{ownerKey}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM USER_PROFILE_MEMORY WHERE OWNER_KEY=#{ownerKey} AND RECORD_ID=#{recordId} AND REVISION=#{revision}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_PROFILE_AUDIT (OWNER_KEY, RECORD_ID, ACTION_CODE, REVISION, OCCURRED_AT) VALUES (#{ownerKey}, #{recordId}, #{actionCode}, #{revision}, #{occurredAt})
